description: This file defines a mock class 'GstDispatcherThreadFactoryMock' for unit testing, which implements the 'IGstDispatcherThreadFactory' interface. It uses Google Mock to mock the 'createGstDispatcherThread' method, and is part of the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace. The file includes licensing information and include guards.

classes.name: GstDispatcherThreadFactoryMock
